entities.name: Methyl ester substrate
observations: The encoded reactant contains a methyl ester, represented as COC(=O), attached to the substituted heteroaromatic scaffold.
The aryl nitrile, heteroaromatic ring, and benzylic framework are retained in the corresponding product according to the close reaction match.

entities.name: Carboxylic acid product
observations: The encoded product corresponds to replacement of the methyl ester methoxy group by hydroxyl, giving the carboxylic acid.
The transformation is assigned as ester hydrolysis/basic saponification.

entities.name: Methyl ester saponification
observations: Basic hydrolysis cleaves the ester methyl C–O bond and, after protonation, yields the free carboxylic acid.
A close database record used NaOH in ethanol for about 1.5 hours and reported 63% yield.
A related record used inorganic carbonate-type conditions in DMSO at low temperature for about 4 hours and reported 67% yield.

entities.name: NaOH ethanol hydrolysis
observations: Database-matched condition: NaOH in ethanol, approximately 1.5 hours, followed by acidic workup to isolate the carboxylic acid; reported yield 63%.

entities.name: Carbonate DMSO hydrolysis
observations: Related condition: inorganic carbonate-type base/components in DMSO at approximately 2.5 °C for about 4 hours; reported yield 67% in a close record.
This is a secondary alternative rather than the most direct match.
